WITH customer_annual AS (
  SELECT c.customerid, c.segment, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM public.customers c
  JOIN public.yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
  SELECT segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_annual
  GROUP BY segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
  SELECT ca.segment, ca.total_consumption
  FROM customer_annual ca
  JOIN min_per_segment mps ON ca.segment = mps.segment AND ca.total_consumption = mps.min_consumption
),
segment_averages AS (
  SELECT segment, 
         SUM(total_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
  FROM lowest_customers
  GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT 
  'SME - LAM' AS difference,
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'SME') - 
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT

  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'LAM') - 
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS value

SELECT

  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'KAM') -

    SELECT 
        c.segment,
        SUBSTRING(ym.date FROM 1 FOR 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM public.yearmonth ym
    JOIN public.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTRING(ym.date FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.segment, SUBSTRING(ym.date FROM 1 FOR 4)
)
SELECT 
    segment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2012,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2013,
    (MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption END)) AS increase,
    CASE 
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption END) != 0 
        THEN ((MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption END)) 
              / MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption END)) * 100
        ELSE NULL
    END AS pct_increase
FROM yearly_consumption

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (

),
oxygen_counts AS (

)
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count)::numeric AS avg_oxygen_atoms

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (

  FROM public.molecule

),
single_bonds AS (

atom_counts AS (

    FROM public.connected c

    JOIN public.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')

)

    b.molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
  FROM public.bond b
  WHERE b.bond_type = '='
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
max_double_bonds AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, double_bond_count

  ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
  LIMIT 1

    b.bond_type,
    a1.atom_id AS atom_1_id,
    a1.element AS atom_1_element,
    a2.atom_id AS atom_2_id,
    a2.element AS atom_2_element
FROM public.bond b
JOIN public.connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN public.atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN public.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' 
  AND b.bond_type = '#'
  AND a1.atom_id < a2.atom_id
ORDER BY b.bond_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM public.connected c
JOIN public.atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'

SELECT b.bond_id, a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
FROM public.bond b
JOIN public.connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN public.atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN public.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
ORDER BY b.bond_id

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS NUMERIC(10,5)) AS proportion_percentage
FROM public.bond b
JOIN public.molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM public.bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
p_or_br_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM public.atom
    WHERE element IN ('p', 'br')
),
target_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM triple_bond_molecules
    INTERSECT
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM p_or_br_molecules
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms
FROM public.atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM target_molecules)

decision.text: Should the percentage of chlorine be calculated over all atoms that are part of any single bond (counting each atom once), or over all atom-bond incidences (counting each atom per single bond)? Also, should both atoms of each bond (atom_id and atom_id2) be considered, or only one of them?

decision.sql:
SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    a1.atom_id AS atom_id_1,
    a1.element AS element_1,
    a2.atom_id AS atom_id_2,
    a2.element AS element_2,
    b.bond_type
FROM public.connected c
JOIN public.atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN public.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN public.bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) * 100 AS percentage_cl_per_carcinogenic_molecule
FROM public.molecule m
JOIN public.atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM public.atom a
JOIN public.molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY tally DESC

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) / COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_ratio
FROM public.molecule m
JOIN public.atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM public.molecule m
JOIN public.atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5
ORDER BY m.molecule_id

SELECT 
    s.sname AS school_name,
    s.avgscrwrite::bigint AS writing_score,
    sch.phone AS communication_number
FROM public.satscores s
JOIN public.schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.avgscrwrite::text != 'nan'
  AND (
    sch.opendate > '1991-12-31' 
    OR (sch.closeddate IS NOT NULL AND sch.closeddate < '2000-01-01')
  )
ORDER BY s.sname

WITH locally_funded AS (
  SELECT 
    s.school AS school_name,
    s.doctype AS doc_type,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_5_17,
    (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS diff
  FROM public.schools s
  JOIN public.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
  WHERE f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
),
avg_diff AS (
  SELECT AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM locally_funded
)
SELECT 
  lf.school_name,
  lf.doc_type
FROM locally_funded lf
CROSS JOIN avg_diff ad
WHERE lf.diff > ad.avg_diff
ORDER BY lf.diff DESC

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        "School Name",
        "Enrollment (K-12)",

    FROM public.frpm
    WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT "School Name", eligible_free_rate
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN (10, 11)
ORDER BY rn
